en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a grand, ornate building along a broad, tree-lined avenue. The building, in a historic European architectural style, dominates the scene, with detailed facades and a tower on the roof. The top-left of the image contains the printed text 'Sundsvall, Esplanaden.' The reverse side shows handwritten correspondence in Swedish and typical postcard formatting with multilingual headings.
